title: IPC admin.endpoints.add result
description: What an add did. A REFUSAL IS AN ANSWER, not an error: `outcome: refused` names its rule in `refused`, nothing written. `added`: the entry is in the endpoint overlay's `added` member and its two own sets are present and empty; the endpoint is registered and leasable from the answer on. `unchanged`: the overlay's `added` member already holds the id with the same alias and the same client kinds, nothing written (a retry after a lost answer). `endpoint` is the derived EndpointId on `added` and `unchanged`. `detail` is for a log, never parsed.

refused.$comment: Present exactly when outcome is refused, checked in this order: id_not_derived (key is not `<EndpointId>.key`); alias_invalid (outside the alias grammar); key_missing (the key file absent or unreadable); key_mismatch (the file's header derives another id than the name's stem); exists (the id is an authored entry's, or an added one's with another alias or other kinds); alias_taken (another entry, authored or added, holds the alias); bound (authored and added entries would pass 64).
